h1: Admin dashboards your team will want to use
overview: We build the back-office screens your own team uses every day. Instead of asking a developer to change records in the database, your staff can search users, review orders, edit content and take actions from one tidy panel. We agree the tasks with you, build the lists and forms, protect it behind admin-only login and record who changed what, so mistakes are easy to trace.

faq: Is this built on my existing database?
Yes. We connect to your current data so staff see real records. We start on a copy or test database and only go live once you have checked the screens.
Can you use a ready-made admin tool instead?
If a tool such as a low-code panel fits your needs and budget, we say so. Otherwise we build a custom panel that matches your product and does exactly the tasks you list.
How do you keep it secure?
The panel sits behind admin-only login, risky actions need confirmation, and changes are logged. For deeper account protection, our security review service can look at the whole app.
What if my team needs more screens later?
We build in a way that makes new areas easy to add. More screens can be ordered as add-ons or in a new order, and each one is priced in advance.
